## Changes

## Problem Solved
The previous threading approach could cause SQLAlchemy session deadlocks when
the main HTTP request and the daemon thread both tried to access/update the
database simultaneously. This could result in 502 Bad Gateway timeouts.

## Solution
By moving blob operations to the CKAN Jobs Queue:
1. Blob move runs in a separate worker process
2. Each worker has its own DB session (no deadlock)
3. Worker only starts after HTTP response is sent
4. Main request can complete quickly

## Benefits
- No database deadlocks
- Cleaner, more reliable code
- Follows CKAN best practices (use jobs queue for background work)
- Better scalability
- Consistent with existing metadata extraction job
